#en: Cargo hold is... this way! Follow me.
zh: 货舱在这边……跟我来。

#en: It's good that you're trying to repay your debt.
zh: 你想偿还这份恩情，这很好。

#en: If you'd rather stand, no problem.
zh: 你更愿意站着的话，也没问题。

#en: When you think we're ready, just let me know. In the meantime, business as usual! Now, let's get back to it, shall we?
zh: 你觉得我们准备好了就告诉我。在此期间，一切照旧！那么，我们继续吧，好吗？

#en: For the moment, I suggest you keep working on your fleet. Get as many ships as you can! Outfitted with the best weapons, systems, and of course, Skydrops.
zh: 眼下，我建议你继续经营你的舰队。尽量多搞些飞船！装上最好的武器、系统，当然还有空投。

#en: For the sake of secrecy, for now, I'm going to hold off on sharing the exact details of my "take out Watchtower" plan -- until you think we're good to go.
zh: 为了保密，眼下我先不透露我那个"干掉瞭望塔"计划的具体细节——等你觉得我们可以行动的时候再说。

#en: I don't think I'm ready for this right now.
zh: 我觉得我现在还没准备好。

#en: From my experience, a Unity jump just buys you time. But that's all.
zh: 以我的经验，一次归一跳跃只能为你争取时间。仅此而已。

#en: Well, sure! We could always try. But something tells me another Watchtower would just be there, ready to start the hunt all over again.
zh: 嗯，当然！我们随时可以试试。但我有种感觉，另一个瞭望塔就在那里，准备好重新开始追捕。

#en: Can't we just Unity jump to another universe?
zh: 我们就不能直接归一跳到另一个宇宙吗？

#en: What if I find Unity? Maybe I can escape that way?
zh: 如果我找到归一呢？也许我能那样逃走？

#en: At best, a Unity jump just buys you time. And probably less than you think.
zh: 一次归一跳跃最多只能为你争取时间。而且大概比你想的还少。

#en: Hah, already tried that myself... Sure, it gave me a head start, but that didn't stop them finding me again.
zh: 哈，我自己已经试过了……是，它让我抢先一步，但那并没阻止他们再次找到我。

#en: Hahah, ho-- hold on! I admire you being proactive, but we shouldn't rush this! We still have time...
zh: 哈哈哈，等——等等！我很欣赏你的主动，但这事不能急！我们还有时间……

#en: Then let's take the fight to Watchtower.
zh: 那我们就主动出击，打上门去。

#en: Why does Watchtower see Starborn as dangerous?
zh: 瞭望塔为什么认为星裔危险？

#en: Although, that certainly doesn't excuse everything they've done! And I'm not more willing to hand myself over to their "tender care".
zh: 不过，这当然不能为他们所做的一切开脱！我也更不会愿意把自己交给他们的"温柔照料"。

#en: You know, now that I think about it... Watchtower might actually have a point...
zh: 你知道，现在想想……瞭望塔也许还真有点道理……

#en: At least, some of them... You've experienced that firsthand. Powerful beings with strange unexplained abilities? Who wouldn't be concerned?
zh: 至少其中一些……你亲身经历过。拥有无法解释的怪异能力的强大存在？谁不会担心？

#en: Well, I suppose...  I suppose that's because they are dangerous!
zh: 嗯，我想……我想那是因为他们确实危险！

#en: But whatever this weapon is, they seem to believe a fleet won't be able to counter it...
zh: 但不管这件武器是什么，他们似乎相信舰队无法对抗它……

#en: Seems our fleet strategy worked a little too well! Forced them to change tactics...
zh: 看来我们的舰队策略效果有点太好了！逼得他们改变战术……

#en: Nope! Not really... All I could find was -- that in response to our actions, Watchtower have been pouring a lot of resources into its development.
zh: 没有！并没有……我只查到——为应对我们的行动，瞭望塔在它的研发上投入了大量资源。

#en: Can you tell me anything about the weapon?
zh: 关于这件武器，你能告诉我点什么吗？

#en: I won't lie, it will be dicey. But it's the only way I can see us not ending up in a containment cell for the rest of our lives...
zh: 我不骗你，这会很凶险。但这是我能想到的唯一办法，让我们不至于在收容舱里度过余生……

#en: Instead of letting Watchtower come to us when they're good and ready, we go to them -- before they've had time to finish their new weapon! And we take them outta the picture!
zh: 与其等瞭望塔准备就绪后找上门来，不如我们主动去找他们——趁他们还没时间完成新武器！然后把他们从棋盘上拿掉！

#en: So, I propose we instead do the unexpected!
zh: 所以，我提议我们反其道而行之！

#en: By letting us build and maintain a fleet, Watchtower thinks they've kept us distracted. They'll think we're content to keep to our current status quo.
zh: 允许我们组建和维持舰队，瞭望塔自以为让我们分了心。他们会以为我们满足于维持现状。

#en: Watchtower knows more than I thought... But they don't know that WE know that THEY know. Which gives us an advantage! I... think...?
zh: 瞭望塔知道的比我想的多……但他们不知道"我们知道他们知道"。这就给了我们优势！我……想……？

#en: I believe Watchtower's current game plan -- is to keep us occupied until this "weapon" is complete, and then hit us with everything they have.
zh: 我相信瞭望塔目前的打算是——拖住我们，直到那件"武器"完成，然后用全力对付我们。

#en: Presumably, it's some kind of weapon, but I couldn't uncover any real specifics. Only that a fleet won't offer any protection from it.
zh: 据推测，那是某种武器，但我查不到任何具体细节。只知道舰队无法提供任何防护。

#en: Well, apparently we're high-priority targets. Enough of a problem for Watchtower to be engineering a whole new technology just to capture us.
zh: 嗯，显然我们是高优先级目标。麻烦到瞭望塔要专门研发一整套新技术来抓我们。

#en: What's the plan? What do we do?
zh: 计划是什么？我们该怎么做？

#en: Me because I'm Starborn, and you because you're on the path to being one.
zh: 我是因为我星裔的身份，你是因为你正走在成为星裔的路上。

#en: Busywork -- to keep us occupied, and laboring under the increasingly false impression that we're safe. Which turns out, we are not.
zh: 都是些杂活——为了拖住我们，让我们在日益虚假的安全感里埋头忙碌。而事实证明，我们并不安全。

#en: Only... with us, their usual tactics aren't working, and they are well aware of it. All the hostile ships they've sent our way?
zh: 只不过……对我们，他们惯用的手段不起作用，而他们对此心知肚明。他们派来的那些敌意飞船？

#en: I have no idea how much they know about Starborn, though. The info I unearthed was scant, at best. Watchtower like keeping their secrets...
zh: 不过我不知道他们对星裔了解多少。我挖出的信息充其量也只是零星的。瞭望塔喜欢保守秘密……

#en: That could've been accidental, but that's not likely. I always suspected they were after me because I'm Starborn, and the database just confirmed it.
zh: 那可能是偶然，但不太像。我一直怀疑他们盯上我是因为我星裔的身份，而数据库刚刚证实了这一点。

#en: So it seems! I mean, the clues were already there. They do have technology able to incapacitate and contain us...
zh: 看来是了！我是说，线索本来就在那儿。他们确实有能让我们失能并收容我们的技术……

#en: Watchtower know about Starborn?
zh: 瞭望塔知道星裔的存在？

#en: Tell me what this all means for us.
zh: 告诉我这一切对我们意味着什么。

#en: Sorry, I need to go. Can we pick this up later?
zh: 抱歉，我得走了。这事能以后再说吗？

#en: Sure, I'll just hang out here until you're ready.
zh: 好，我就待在这儿，等你准备好。

#en: I knew where the database would be because I'd found it before. Although this time, thanks to Gren's decryption program, we were able to learn a lot more...
zh: 我知道数据库会在哪，因为我以前就找到过它。不过这次，多亏格伦的破解程序，我们得以了解到多得多的东西……

#en: Most of the data was fragmented, but before it erased itself -- it was enough to learn about Watchtower. To learn they'd been keeping tabs on me...
zh: 大部分数据都已碎片化，但在它自我抹除之前——已足够让我了解瞭望塔。足够让我知道他们一直盯梢着我……

#en: There were a few trinkets, shards of a breached hull... but the most interesting thing was a mostly intact computer. The database.
zh: 有几件小物件，破损船体的碎片……但最有趣的是一台基本完好的计算机。那个数据库。

#en: Although I didn't yet know what Watchtower was, I tailed the scavengers, took care of them, and went to investigate what it was they'd found.
zh: 当时我还不知道瞭望塔是什么，我跟踪了那些拾荒者，解决了他们，然后去查看他们到底发现了什么。

#en: Oh? Did-- Did I not explain that...? Okay. In my previous universe, I came across a bunch of scavengers -- picking over the remains of a Watchtower ship.
zh: 哦？我——我没解释过吗……？好吧。在我上一个宇宙里，我碰到一群拾荒者——正在翻拣一艘瞭望塔飞船的残骸。

#en: Tell you what, once we're done talking about Watchtower, I'll be happy to answer anything you want to know.
zh: 这样吧，等我们把瞭望塔的事谈完，你想知道什么我都很乐意回答。

#en: Yeah! I bet you do.
zh: 是啊！我猜也是。

#en: How did you know about the Database in the first place?
zh: 你一开始是怎么知道那个数据库的？

#en: I have more questions about Starborn.
zh: 关于星裔，我还有更多问题。

#en: They consider us dangerous. A "threat to mankind", even. That's why they've been trying to capture us.
zh: 他们认为我们危险。甚至是"对人类的威胁"。所以一直想抓我们。

#en: First off, Watchtower know what Starborn are. I mean, I always suspected as much, but now I know for sure. Only, they call Starborn "Deviants". Hah, charming.
zh: 首先，瞭望塔知道星裔是什么。我是说，我一直这么怀疑，但现在我确定了。只不过，他们把星裔称作"异常体"。哈，真动人。

#en: What are Watchtower up to? What did you learn?
zh: 瞭望塔在搞什么？你了解到了什么？

#en: I know what they're planning now, and... I'm not gonna lie, it's... it's not good.
zh: 我现在知道他们在谋划什么了，而且……我不骗你，很不妙。

#en: But, back to the subject of Watchtower... The database. With Gren's help, I pulled a lot more info than we usually could...
zh: 不过，回到瞭望塔的话题……那个数据库。在格伦的帮助下，我提取到的信息比平时多得多……

#en: Anyway, if there's anything you wanna know about me, Starborn, or Unity... Just ask, okay? I'll answer what I can.
zh: 总之，如果你想了解我、星裔或归一的任何事……尽管问，好吗？我能答的都答。

#en: Maybe, maybe not...
zh: 也许吧，也许不是……

#en: But for some reason, whatever Watchtower shot you with seemed to delay that. Maybe some sorta... anti-Starborn weapon? I don't know...
zh: 但不知为何，瞭望塔用来射击你的东西似乎延迟了那个过程。也许是某种……反星裔武器？我不知道……

#en: Normally, when Starborn are killed, they dissolve into a sort of glowing dust almost right away.
zh: 通常，星裔被杀后，几乎会立刻消散成一种发光的尘埃。

#en: Yeah... Sorry. But hey, If it's any consolation, it seemed fairly quick and painless? Although... strangely, your body did linger longer than usual.
zh: 是啊……抱歉。不过，如果说这能让你好受点，过程似乎相当快、也没什么痛苦？虽然……奇怪的是，你的身体确实比平常存留得久。

#en: I appreciate it, but you really don't owe me anything.
zh: 我很感激，但你真的不欠我什么。

#en: It's the least I can do...
zh: 这是我至少能做的……

#en: Ah, don't mention it...
zh: 啊，别提这个……

#en: I didn't realize what you'd gone through. Thank you.
zh: 我没想到你经历过这些。谢谢你。

#en: How difficult was it to escape?
zh: 逃出去有多难？

#en: I owe you one! That's why I tracked you down. Brought you in on this whole "fleet thing". I had to pay you back for saving me! I... I had to keep you safe.
zh: 我欠你一次！所以我才找到你。拉你入伙搞这档"舰队的事"。我必须报答你救我的恩情！我……我必须护你周全。

#en: I know you're not technically the same person I met on that station, but...
zh: 我知道严格来说，你不是我在那座空间站上遇到的那个人，但是……

#en: They killed me?
zh: 他们杀了我？

#en: There were waves of Watchtower troops, robots, station defenses. Multiple times I thought "This is it.". But you! I mean, the other you...
zh: 一波又一波的瞭望塔士兵、机器人、空间站防御。有好几次我都想"到头了"。但你！我是说，另一个你……

#en: Well, my retelling may have made it sound easy, however, it was anything but.
zh: 嗯，我的复述也许让它听起来很容易，然而完全不是那么回事。

#en: If I had tried to escape by myself, there's no way I would have made it.
zh: 如果我一个人去逃，绝不可能成功。

#en: Every obstacle that blocked our way, they'd just tear through it. I could tell how much it took out of them, but they just wouldn't give up.
zh: 每一个挡住去路的障碍，他们都直接撕开。我看得出那有多消耗他们，但他们就是不肯放弃。

#en: Every obstacle that blocked our way. She'd just tear through it. I could tell how much it took out of her, but she wouldn't give up.
zh: 每一个挡住去路的障碍。她都直接撕开。我看得出那有多消耗她，但她不肯放弃。

#en: Every obstacle that blocked our way, he'd just... tear through it. I could tell how much it took out of him, but he... he just wouldn't give up.
zh: 每一个挡住去路的障碍，他都直接……撕开。我看得出那有多消耗他，但他……他就是不肯放弃。

#en: What did Watchtower do to you?
zh: 瞭望塔对你做了什么？

#en: Yeah, I escaped. But Watchtower kept tracking me down. So I jumped universes! I now had a second chance. But there was someone else who needed my help...
zh: 是啊，我逃了出来。但瞭望塔一直找到我。于是我跳到了别的宇宙！我有了第二次机会。但还有另一个人需要我的帮助……

#en: I had a chance for a do-over! To avoid being captured by Watchtower this time. But I realized there was someone who deserved that more than me...
zh: 我本有机会重来一次！这次避开被瞭望塔抓获。但我意识到，有个人比我更该得到这个机会……

#en: So I gathered the Artifacts, constructed the Armillary, and passed through The Unity! Ended up in the universe you and I are in right now.
zh: 于是我收集了神器，建造了浑天仪，穿过了归一！最后来到了你我现在所在的这个宇宙。

#en: It became clear there was nowhere I could hide. At least, not in that universe.
zh: 很明显，我无处可藏。至少在那个宇宙里无处可藏。

#en: Yeah, I escaped. But after that, no matter where I went or how much I tried to keep a low profile, Watchtower always managed to find me.
zh: 是啊，我逃了出来。但那之后，无论我去哪儿、多么努力地低调行事，瞭望塔总能找到我。

#en: But you obviously made it out alive.
zh: 但你显然活着出来了。

#en: I don't know if the experiments had a purpose to them or not, but they were almost always painful.
zh: 我不知道那些实验有没有目的，但它们几乎总是痛苦的。

#en: But every so often they'd bring me out for... "research". They'd force some sort of collar around my neck and escort me to their laboratory.
zh: 但每隔一段时间，他们就会带我出去做……"研究"。他们会强行给我脖子上套上某种项圈，把我押到他们的实验室。

#en: Most of the time, they just kept me locked in a containment chamber. They seemed to be able to suppress my Starborn powers while I was in there.
zh: 大多数时候，他们只是把我锁在收容舱里。我在里面时，他们似乎能压制我的星裔能力。

#en: But it was long enough to grow out a beard at least twice! Heh. If I had to guess, I'd say I was in their custody for... at least eight months.
zh: 但这时间足够让我至少长出两次胡子！嘿。要我说，我被他们关押了……至少八个月。

#en: Not sure, really. It was difficult to keep track of time...
zh: 真不确定。在里面很难计算时间……

#en: How long were you imprisoned for?
zh: 你被关押了多久？

#en: But I can say that you looked roughly the same, and had a great sense of humor, and when the cards were on the table, you risked it all just to help someone.
zh: 但我可以说，你长得大致一样，很有幽默感，而且到了关键时刻，你愿豁出一切去帮别人。

#en: Honestly, I think those notes were the only thing that stopped me from losing all sense of hope...
zh: 老实说，我想正是那些字条，让我没有彻底失去希望……

#en: That didn't stop us talking, though! We'd leave little notes for each other in the containment chambers they cycled us through.
zh: 不过那并没有阻止我们交流！在他们轮换我们的收容舱里，我们会给对方留小字条。

#en: In fact, the only vocal exchanges we ever had was hearing each others' screams during Watchtower's "research" sessions.
zh: 事实上，我们唯一的声音交流，就是在瞭望塔的"研究"时段听到彼此的惨叫。

#en: That's a complicated question.... Until the day we escaped, we'd never actually met in person before.
zh: 这问题很复杂……直到我们逃跑那天，我们其实从未真正见过面。

#en: What was the other me like?
zh: 另一个我是什么样的人？

#en: What happened after you got free?
zh: 你脱身之后发生了什么？

#en: We were being held on a starstation. So to escape, we had to fight our way to a docking port. But before we could board a ship, they killed you.
zh: 我们被关在一座星际站里。所以要逃就得一路打到对接口。但在我们登上飞船之前，他们杀了你。

#en: ...I saw you. Minus half your head. I have no idea what they shot you with, but... *sigh* There was nothing I could do, you... you were already gone.
zh: ……我看见了你。少了半个脑袋。我不知道他们用的是什么武器，但……*叹气*我无能为力，你……你已经走了。

#en: And then, just as we were about to board a ship... I turned around and saw--
zh: 然后，就在我们即将登船的时候……我转过身，看到——

#en: At this point, Watchtower knew we'd escaped, so we had to fight to get to the docking bay. It was tough, but having Starborn powers sure helped!
zh: 这时瞭望塔已经知道我们逃了，所以我们得一路打到对接舱。很难，但有星裔能力确实帮了大忙！

#en: It didn't take long to figure out we were being held on a starstation, so the plan was simple! Commandeer a ship, and get the hell outta there.
zh: 没用多久就弄清我们被关在一座星际站里，所以计划很简单！抢一艘飞船，赶紧离开那鬼地方。

#en: Seemed like they'd been there for a long time. Yet somehow, one day, they broke themselves free. And instead of just running for it, they risked their life to free me too.
zh: 他们似乎已经在那里很久了。可不知怎的，有一天，他们挣脱了束缚。而且他们没有只顾自己逃跑，而是冒着生命危险把我也放了出来。

#en: Seemed like she'd been there for a long time. Yet somehow, one day, she broke herself free. And instead of just running for it, she risked her life to free me too.
zh: 她似乎已经在那里很久了。可不知怎的，有一天，她挣脱了束缚。而且她没有只顾自己逃跑，而是冒着生命危险把我也放了出来。

#en: Seemed like he'd been there for a long time. Yet somehow, one day, he broke himself free. And instead of just running for it, he risked his life to free me too.
zh: 他似乎已经在那里很久了。可不知怎的，有一天，他挣脱了束缚。而且他没有只顾自己逃跑，而是冒着生命危险把我也放了出来。

#en: I want answers, but don't waste my time. Make it quick.
zh: 我想要答案，但别浪费我的时间。快点说。

#en: ...Ah, but maybe you need context as to why I want to do that...
zh: ……啊，不过也许你需要知道我为什么想那么做……

#en: That's easy, I told you that when we first met! I want to do everything I can to keep you safe from Watchtower.
zh: 这简单，我们初次见面时我就说过！我想尽我所能，让你免受瞭望塔的威胁。

#en: That answers some questions, but what do you want with me?
zh: 这解答了一些问题，但你想从我这儿得到什么？

#en: Forget about you being Starborn. Just tell me what you want.
zh: 别管你星裔的事了。直接告诉我你想要什么。

#en: Take your time and explain everything.
zh: 你慢慢说，把一切都解释清楚。

#en: I don't know yet. Not fully...
zh: 我还不知道。不完全知道……

#en: I know that's how some Starborn do things, but not me. I'm not here for your Artifacts. I'm here for--... other reasons.
zh: 我知道有些星裔是那么做的，但我不是。我不是为你的神器而来。我是为了——……别的原因。

#en: ...What?! No! No, definitely not.
zh: ……什么？！不！不，绝对不是。

#en: But that's it! No one else.
zh: 就这些！没有别人了。

#en: And now that I think about it, maybe also any other Starborn I've met who also just happened to have jumped to this universe. They'd know.
zh: 而且现在想想，也许还有我遇到过的、恰好也跳到这个宇宙的其他星裔。他们会知道。

#en: In this universe? No. No one else knows I'm Starborn, just you. Oh, and I guess Watchtower as well.
zh: 在这个宇宙？没有。除了你，没人知道我星裔的身份。哦，我想瞭望塔也算。

#en: But before I could even think about revealing anything...
zh: 但我还没来得及考虑透露任何事……

#en: I thought about it. I could tell you were already Starborn, so I wasn't going to disrupt your journey on the road to The Unity.
zh: 我想过。我看得出你已经是星裔了，所以我不打算打扰你通往归一的路。

#en: Besides, before I could even think about revealing anything...
zh: 再说，我还没来得及考虑透露任何事……

#en: You weren't... ready. You were and still are on the road to The Unity, but at that point, it was simply too soon for you to know.
zh: 你还没……准备好。你当时在、现在仍在通往归一的路上，但在那个时候，让你知道还太早。

#en: Are you after my Artifacts?
zh: 你是冲着我的神器来的吗？

#en: I needed to see what kind of person you were. What you were really like. And it turns out you were pretty much what I expected!
zh: 我需要看看你是怎样的人。真实的你是什么样。结果你跟我预期的差不多！

#en: Does anyone else know what you are?
zh: 还有别人知道你的身份吗？

#en: What exactly are Watchtower planning?
zh: 瞭望塔到底在谋划什么？

#en: When we first met, why not tell me you were Starborn?
zh: 我们初次见面时，为什么不告诉我你是星裔？

#en: Ugh... I'm gonna have a hell of a time explaining all of this to the boss...
zh: 呃……要把这一切跟老大解释清楚，我可有的受了……

#en: ...H-Hey... Why's our ship undocking...? You didn't say anything about taking it for yourself!!
zh: ……嘿——嘿……我们的飞船怎么在脱离对接……？你可没说要把它据为己有！！

#en: I'm not some pushover you can just bully into submission.
zh: 我可不是那种能被你吓唬屈服的软柿子。

#en: Yeah, okay. Maybe I hear what you're saying...
zh: 行吧。也许我听懂你的意思了……

#en: Didn't come here to negotiate. Give me what I came for, and this can be over.
zh: 我来这儿不是谈判的。把我要的东西给我，这事就算完。

#en: You're not the only one trying to get something done here!
zh: 想在这办成事的不只你一个！

#en: Hmm... You've got my attention...
zh: 嗯……你引起我的兴趣了……

#en: I've got a job to do, and you're in my way.
zh: 我有活要干，而你挡了我的道。

#en: What you're asking for ain't that simple.
zh: 你要的东西可没那么简单。

#en: That's reasonable. *inhale* Maybe there's a way we can work something out...
zh: 有道理。*吸气*也许我们能商量出个办法……

#en: You've got a lot of nerve saying that...
zh: 你这话可真有胆量……

#en: I don't know about that, but uh... maybe I'm rethinking things.
zh: 这我可说不准，不过呃……也许我该重新考虑考虑。

#en: I'm not asking for the world, just what's in that hold.
zh: 我不是要整个世界，只要那个货舱里的东西。

#en: You might think you're in control here, but you're not.
zh: 你可能以为这里你说了算，但并不是。

#en: ...Seriously? You're wasting my time with this crap.
zh: ……认真的？你拿这种废话浪费我的时间。

#en: Cooperation, huh? Alright, I hear you.
zh: 合作，是吧？行，我听你的。

#en: Mm-mm. Doesn't work like that.
zh: 不行。不是那么回事。

#en: Eh... Yeah, maybe... I guess I see your point.
zh: 呃……是啊，也许……我想我明白你的意思了。

#en: If you give me what I want, I'll be out of here with no trouble. No need for anyone to get hurt.
zh: 把我要的给我，我就安安静静离开这儿。没必要让任何人受伤。

#en: You're making this harder than it has to be. I just need what's on that ship.
zh: 你这是在把事情弄得比必要的更麻烦。我只要那艘飞船上的东西。

#en: I'm not asking for much, just a little cooperation.
zh: 我要求不多，只要一点配合。

#en: That sounds like a threat. I don't take kindly to threats.
zh: 这听着像威胁。我可不喜欢被人威胁。

#en: I don't want any trouble either. Not really...
zh: 我也不想惹麻烦。真的不想……

#en: Alright, alright, no need to get all worked up! I know when I'm dealing with someone outta my league...
zh: 行了，行了，没必要大动肝火！我知道自己什么时候是在跟惹不起的人打交道……

#en: I'm just looking for something from your ship, not a fight. Unless you feel like changing that?
zh: 我只是想在你这艘飞船上找点东西，不是来打架的。除非你想改变一下？

#en: ...I've heard of people like you. Look, I'm sorry. Okay?
zh: ……我听说过你这样的人。听着，我道歉。行吗？

#en: Step aside, or learn firsthand how a Ronin deals with your kind.
zh: 让开，否则就亲身体会一下浪人是怎么对付你这种人的。

#en: Sure thing. We'll talk soon, okay? See you back at Stardock.
zh: 没问题。我们回头再谈，好吗？星坞见。

#en: Once we're back at Stardock, I'll need just a little time to look over the database. So, I hope you got a book to read or something.
zh: 回到星坞后，我需要一点时间仔细研究那个数据库。所以，希望你带了本书之类的打发时间。

#en: Great! Take a seat and get comfortable. I'll arrange for someone to come pickup your ship.
zh: 太好了！找个位子坐舒服点。我会安排人来接你的飞船。

#en: That's okay, I'll make my own way back.
zh: 没关系，我自己回去。

#en: Sure, I'll travel back with you.
zh: 好，我跟你一起回去。

#en: Or, I suppose I could give you a ride back. If you'd prefer?
zh: 或者，我想我也可以载你回去。如果你愿意的话？

#en: I'm going to take this ship back to Stardock, see if Gren can help me with the database. Meet me at Stardock as soon as you can, and I'll answer everything, I promise.
zh: 我要把这艘飞船开回星坞，看看格伦能不能帮我处理数据库。你尽快来星坞找我，我什么都回答你，我保证。

#en: Listen, we definitely need to talk. About many, many things! But it's going to have to wait just a little bit longer!
zh: 听着，我们确实得谈谈。要谈的事情多得是！但还得再等一小会儿！

#en: ...Ah, this is more than I thought we'd be dealing with... I-- I need to get this database back, try to pull more info from it.
zh: ……啊，这比我想的要棘手得多……我——我得把这个数据库带回去，试着从里面提取更多信息。

#en: Let's see you talk your way outta this!
zh: 看你怎么靠嘴皮子脱身！

#en: Ugh, shut up already! I don't take orders from you, or anyone else!
zh: 呃，闭嘴吧！我不听你的，也不听任何人的！

#en: I know that I don't seem like "Torin the Trustworthy" right now, but you--... You just have to trust me, okay?
zh: 我知道我现在看起来不像"值得信赖的托林"，但你——……你只要相信我就行，好吗？

#en: You've been hiding stuff from me. I'm not sure I can trust you.
zh: 你一直对我隐瞒事情。我不确定能信任你。

#en: We will! You have my word on that, just-- I know I may have already said this a whole bunch, but, just... not yet.
zh: 我们会的！这一点我向你保证，只是——我知道这话我可能已经说过一大堆了，但是，只是……还不到时候。

#en: We need to talk about you being Starborn.
zh: 我们得谈谈你星裔身份的事。

#en: They've been planning something, something big. Something that a fleet can't protect us from.
zh: 他们一直在谋划某件事，一件大事。一件舰队无法保护我们免受其害的事。

#en: Watchtower. The database suggests they've been doing more than just "watching" us.
zh: 瞭望塔。数据库显示，他们做的远不只是"注视"我们。

#en: And I'd imagine you have more than a few questions you'll want answering, and I'm more than willing to explain myself! But before we get to that...
zh: 而且我猜你有不少问题想要答案，我也非常乐意解释！但在说那些之前……

#en: I'm sorry I didn't tell you sooner, it's just... Well, there were reasons! Important ones!
zh: 抱歉没有早点告诉你，只是……嗯，是有原因的！很重要的原因！

#en: ...And they know I'm Starborn.
zh: ……而且他们知道我是星裔。

#en: ...And they know that both you and I are Starborn.
zh: ……而且他们知道你我都是星裔。

#en: You lied to me. Why didn't you tell me this?
zh: 你骗了我。你为什么不告诉我？

#en: I'm not surprised. It did seem like you'd already figured it out.
zh: 我不意外。看来你早就猜到了。

#en: Technically, I didn't lie! But I understand your meaning...
zh: 严格来说，我没撒谎！但我明白你的意思……

#en: Hold on. YOU'RE Starborn?
zh: 等等。你是星裔？

#en: I knew it! I knew you were Starborn.
zh: 我就知道！我就知道你是星裔。

#en: Yeah. Yeah, I'm... I'm Starborn.
zh: 是啊。是啊，我……我是星裔。

#en: Oh, hold on. There's more. They also know about your connection to Constellation, about the Artifacts...
zh: 哦，等等。还有。他们也知道你与星宿座的关系，知道神器的事……

#en: What does this mean for us?
zh: 这对我们意味着什么？

#en: To be blunt, they're violent psychopaths who will scavenge anything useful and blast whoever gets in their way.
zh: 直说吧，他们是暴力的疯子，会搜刮一切有用的东西，并炸掉任何挡道的人。

#en: Spacers are... not exactly the friendliest bunch. Disorganized, vicious, and more often than not, heavily armed.
zh: 太空劫匪……算不上最友善的一群人。散乱、凶狠，而且多半全副武装。

#en: I've unsealed the docking hatch. Go ahead, take whatever you want. Not like I really care...
zh: 我把对接舱门打开了。去吧，想要什么拿什么。反正我也不在乎……

#en: Fine! Not usually in the habit of handing things over for free, but you made your point.
zh: 好吧！我一般不会白送东西，但你把话说清楚了。

#en: And what's the good news?
zh: 那好消息是什么？

#en: Not as vicious as some of the other pirate groups, but you still wouldn't want to turn your back on them.
zh: 不像其他一些海盗团伙那么凶狠，但你还是不能对他们掉以轻心。

#en: They'll happily work together to swipe big hauls, but more often than not, they operate in small, independent groups.
zh: 他们会乐于联手干一票大的，但多数时候，他们以小股独立团伙行动。

#en: Think of 'em as a loose confederation of cargo thieves.
zh: 把他们想成一个松散的货物窃贼联盟。

#en: And what's the bad news?
zh: 那坏消息呢？

#en: Sorry, I lied. I thought it might soften the blow.
zh: 抱歉，我骗你的。我以为这样能让打击轻一点。

#en: The good news! Ah... there... there isn't any.
zh: 好消息！啊……没有……没有好消息。

#en: Yeah, they know that was us. They know about Harper, Gren, Dr. Laine, even B.A.B.S. They... they know everything!
zh: 是啊，他们知道那是我们干的。他们知道哈珀、格伦、莱恩博士，甚至B.A.B.S.。他们……他们什么都知道！

#en: Might as well start with the good news.
zh: 那就先从好消息说起吧。

#en: Let's get the bad news out of the way.
zh: 先把坏消息说了吧。

#en: And it seems we have ourselves a classic good news, bad news situation... Which do you wanna hear first...?
zh: 看来我们碰上了经典的好消息坏消息套餐……你想先听哪个……？

#en: Well, I didn't read everything, but I think I got the gist of it all.
zh: 嗯，我没有全读完，但我想我大致抓到了要点。

#en: They definitely know about one of their Listening Posts going quiet...
zh: 他们肯定知道其中一个监听哨失联了……

#en: They definitely know about a handful of their Listening Posts going quiet...
zh: 他们肯定知道有好几个监听哨失联了……

#en: They definitely know about most of their Listening Posts going quiet...
zh: 他们肯定知道大部分监听哨都失联了……

#en: DS1599-A... I do believe this record is yours... Oh yeah, definitely you. No doubt about that... And-- Oh. Oh, well... Well, that's not good.
zh: DS1599-A……我想这份记录是你的……哦对，肯定是你。毫无疑问……而且——哦。哦，好吧……这可不妙。

#en: Hello, here's a familiar entry. "DA1596-B Torin" Uh-huh... And what is this...?
zh: 你好啊，这有条眼熟的记录。"DA1596-B 托林"嗯嗯……这是什么……？

#en: Aha! Watchtower database. Right where it should be.
zh: 啊哈！瞭望塔数据库。就在它该在的地方。

#en: And... we're in! Pulling recent records...
zh: 然后……进去了！正在调取近期记录……

#en: Just give me a few seconds here...
zh: 给我几秒钟……

#en: They know about Stardock, about the fleet you've built to counter their abduction attempts...
zh: 他们知道星坞，知道你为对抗他们的绑架企图而组建的舰队……

#en: Right, the bad news. Watchtower know about everything we've been doing. Like, everything! I don't know how they even learned some of this stuff.
zh: 对，坏消息。我们所做的一切瞭望塔都知道。是一切！我都不知道他们是怎么查到其中一些事情的。

#en: There we are. After you!
zh: 到了。你先请！

#en: You want a fight?! You got one!
zh: 你想打？！那就打！

#en: [3000 Credits] I just need something from the ship's cargo hold. I'm willing to pay.
zh: [3000信用点]我只是要从飞船货舱里取点东西。我愿意付钱。

#en: Docking port is locked up tight. Check the captain's body, they might have the codes we need to open it.
zh: 对接口锁得很严实。检查船长的尸体，他们身上也许有我们需要的开锁密码。

#en: [Attack] I'd rather just kill you.
zh: [攻击]我更想直接杀了你。

#en: You know what? Fine. You got a deal. Help yourself to whatever you came for. Hell, take the whole ship if you want! Hmph. Not like it's mine...
zh: 你知道吗？行。成交。你自己去拿你要的东西吧。见鬼，整艘船你拿去都行！哼。反正也不是我的……

#en: ...Hm. I already sold everything from our recent haul. The buyer's already paid, but hasn't come to pick up yet...
zh: ……嗯。最近这一票的东西我全卖了。买家已经付了钱，但还没来取货……

#en: ...Is that a joke? Heh. Why would we hand anything over to you?
zh: ……这是开玩笑吗？嘿。我们凭什么把东西交给你？

#en: Wait a minute! I just want something you stole. You'd be smart to let me have it.
zh: 等等！我只想要你偷来的一件东西。让我拿走才是明智之举。

#en: I'd rather just use you for target practice.
zh: 我更想拿你练枪靶。

#en: ...What a spineless little shit! Ha-ha-ha! You know what? I changed my mind. Now I don't want you to leave.
zh: ……真是个没骨气的小废物！哈哈哈！你知道吗？我改主意了。现在我不想让你走了。

#en: Fine, I'll leave.
zh: 好吧，我走。

#en: So, I think It's time you to turn around and leave.
zh: 所以，我觉得你该转身离开了。

#en: Lookie what the vacuum blew in...
zh: 瞧瞧真空吹进来了个什么东西……

#en: You lost or something? This is Marauder territory, and I don't remember inviting you!
zh: 你迷路了还是怎么？这里是劫掠者的地盘，我可没记得邀请过你！

#en: This here's spacer territory, friend, and you don't look like no spacer.
zh: 这儿是太空劫匪的地盘，朋友，可你看着不像太空劫匪。

#en: We're not far off now, let's just keep moving.
zh: 我们就快到了，继续走吧。

#en: Lead on, skipper! I'm right behind ya.
zh: 带路吧，队长！我就在你后面。

#en: However, the ship's at a docking port on the opposite side of the station. We're gonna have to hoof it over there.
zh: 不过，那艘飞船在空间站另一侧的对接口。我们得走过去。

#en: I'd bet every credit I have that we'll find the database sitting in that ship's cargo hold.
zh: 我愿意拿我所有信用点打赌，数据库就在那艘飞船的货舱里。

#en: Yup, this is the right place alright. On our approach, I saw another vessel docked...
zh: 对，就是这儿没错。我们进来时，我看到另一艘飞船停靠着……

#en: Oh! And maybe assign someone to the ship I was piloting. Seems a waste not to bring is with us.
zh: 哦！也许可以派个人去开我驾驶的那艘飞船。不带上它好像有点浪费。

#en: Here's the coordinates for the station that's holding the database. Once we're there, I'll be going aboard with you.
zh: 这是存放数据库那座空间站的坐标。到了那儿，我会和你一起登站。

#en: Permission to come aboard, Captain? *chuckle* I always wanted to say that.
zh: 请求登舰，舰长？*轻笑*我一直想这么说一次。

#en: Who are "the Marauders"?
zh: 劫掠者是谁？

#en: Here's the coordinates for the station that's holding the database. I'll be tagging along for this one! So, let's get going.
zh: 这是存放数据库那座空间站的坐标。这次我会跟着一起去！那么，我们出发吧。

#en: Here's the coordinates for the station that's holding the database. Once we arrive, I'll be boarding the station with you. So, let's get going.
zh: 这是存放数据库那座空间站的坐标。我们一到，我就和你一起登站。那么，出发吧。

#en: The information is good. And barring some freak circumstance, the database should provide the exact information we need to know.
zh: 这情报可靠。除非出现什么离奇变故，数据库应该能提供我们需要的准确信息。

#en: It's... kinda complicated, but let's just say I tapped a very reliable source. One that I trust implicitly!
zh: 这……有点复杂，但这么说吧，我有个非常可靠的消息来源。一个我绝对信任的来源！

#en: How'd you find out about this database?
zh: 你是怎么知道这个数据库的？

#en: Once we find the database, I'll have a better idea as to our next move. That is, if we need to move at all.
zh: 找到数据库后，我对下一步行动就会有更清楚的想法。前提是我们需要采取行动。

#en: But so long as nothing indicates a change in their tactics regarding us, I think we should be good.
zh: 但只要没有迹象表明他们对我们的策略有所改变，我想我们就没事。

#en: There's bound to be some record of us on the database. I mean, it's not as if Watchtower don't know who we are.
zh: 数据库里肯定有关于我们的记录。我是说，瞭望塔又不是不知道我们是谁。

#en: In that case, I... I don't know!
zh: 那样的话，我……我不知道！

#en: Who are "the Spacers"?
zh: 太空劫匪是谁？

#en: And what if the reports do mention us?
zh: 那如果报告里确实提到了我们呢？

#en: I know where we can find a Watchtower database. One that's been freshly purloined by a gang of Marauders.
zh: 我知道哪儿能找到瞭望塔的数据库。一伙劫掠者刚偷来的一个。

#en: I know where we can find a Watchtower database. One that's been freshly purloined by a gang of Spacers.
zh: 我知道哪儿能找到瞭望塔的数据库。一伙太空劫匪刚偷来的一个。

#en: If there's no new mentions of us, then we're in the clear! Nothing to worry about. At least, for the time being.
zh: 如果没有新的关于我们的提及，那我们就安全了！没什么可担心的。至少暂时如此。

#en: If we can get access to it, using Gren's decryption program, I should be able to hack the database and pull Watchtower's most recent intelligence reports.
zh: 如果我们能接触到它，用格伦的破解程序，我应该能黑进数据库，调取瞭望塔最新的情报报告。

#en: *sigh* I suppose. But let's take care of this as soon as we can, yeah? Even if just to give me peace of mind.
zh: *叹气*我想是吧。但我们得尽快把这事办了，行吗？哪怕只是让我安心。

#en: Actually, can we talk about something else?
zh: 其实，我们能聊点别的吗？

#en: Not right now. Can we do this later?
zh: 现在不行。能以后再谈吗？

#en: If my fleet is effective, why are you worried?
zh: 如果我的舰队有效，你在担心什么？

#en: *sigh* I suppose I'm just worried we might be bringing a little too much attention to ourselves.
zh: *叹气*我想我只是担心我们有点太引人注目了。

#en: And not to point fingers, because I would never do that! Buuut... you have kinda been at the center for a lot of it.
zh: 我可不是要指责任何人，我绝不会那么做！不——过……很多事情的中心确实算是你。

#en: There's no one particular reason... It's just... recently, there's been a lot going on, you know? A lot of upheaval in the Settled Systems.
zh: 没什么特别的原因……只是……最近发生了很多事，你知道吗？定居星系群动荡不安。

#en: Nothing too crazy! Relatively speaking...
zh: 没什么太夸张的！相对而言……

#en: Adventure? Sure. What did you have in mind?
zh: 冒险？好啊。你有什么想法？

#en: So! I wanna do a little recon. Find out what, if anything, Watchtower might know about our current operation. You up for a little adventure...?
zh: 那么！我想做点小型侦察。查查瞭望塔对我们当前的行动究竟了解多少。想来场小冒险吗……？

#en: But that doesn't mean we're untouchable... If we get complacent, it could end up spelling our doom.
zh: 但这并不意味着我们无人可动……如果我们自满，最终可能招致灭顶之灾。

#en: So far, the fleet you've put together has kept Watchtower at bay. Clearly, we hit on a strategy that works!
zh: 到目前为止，你组建的舰队让瞭望塔无从下手。显然，我们找到了行之有效的策略！

#en: Hey, self-interest or not, it still works out in my favor, so I can't say I'm upset about the arrangement.
zh: 嘿，不管是不是出于私心，这对我也算有利，所以我说不出对这样的安排有什么不满。

#en: I didn't do it for you. I needed a fleet to keep me safe.
zh: 我不是为了你才做的。我需要一支舰队来保护我自己。

#en: Like I said, you're still here! Which means you're obviously doing it right.
zh: 就像我说的，你还活着！这就说明你显然做对了。

#en: Absolutely. You took my fleet idea and you ran with it. Or flew with it? Whatever.
zh: 当然。你采纳了我关于舰队的想法，并把它贯彻到底。或者该说"飞"到底？随便吧。

#en: You really think I've done a good job?
zh: 你真觉得我做得不错？

#en: Right, sorry. Distracted myself... We were talking about Watchtower...
zh: 对，抱歉。我走神了……我们刚才在说瞭望塔……

#en: Thanks. But what did you want to talk about?
zh: 谢谢。不过你想谈什么？

#en: I have little doubt that's why you're still here and not in some Watchtower cell.
zh: 我毫不怀疑，这正是你还没被抓进某个瞭望塔收容舱的原因。

#en: Anyway, I'm glad you took my advice about building a fleet seriously.
zh: 总之，很高兴你认真对待了我关于组建舰队的建议。

#en: True, you could have more ships, but maybe that's just me being greedy. The amount you've got clearly works just fine.
zh: 确实，你本可以有更多飞船，但也许那只是我贪心。你现在这些显然已经够用了。

#en: You have a fair number of ships under your command. More than enough to take care of any common riffraff. Hehe. it's good to see!
zh: 你麾下有不少飞船。对付寻常的乌合之众绰绰有余。嘿嘿。看着真不错！
